chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: The janitor dance and the sand dance for Dick Powell
summary: He choreographed the shovel bit himself and also did a sand dance in the picture for Dick Powell, though he had sand-danced earlier in New York theatres.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: So who choreographed the first number that you do as janitors? It was your own act?
I did. It wasn't no act, no. It wasn't an act, just a bit we did as janitors.
Can you tell me what you did?
Well, I'd shovel coal, fired the furnace and Buck would play while we were doing a song -- I forget the song we were doing -- I don't know if we were doing

"Castles" or what we were doing. We were doing some kind of song, I was dancing and shoveling coal. I think Buck was just doodling on the piano over some stop time music I think it was, 'cause I had the shovel and taps going on in between. It was nice, though. And that was all.
Well, you did a sand dance, didn't you?

Yeah, something like that -- well, I did that for Dick Powell later on from this spot -- we were in two different spots doing this, you know. Where we had the coal there was a dance and with the piano was another dance where I did the sand dance there, see.
Was this the first time you'd done a sand dance?
No, I'd sand danced before that, with the idea of sand before.
Oh, long before that in the theaters in New York, I was doing

sand. I messed with sand for quite a while. When I was doing it for Dick Powell there in that picture, I had it pretty much under control, 'cause I knew what I was doing. You can see, look at me -- see -- I was doing what I was doing. It wasn't like me trying to find something. I shuffled and everything from that picture, you can look at it and tell,'cause I did the sand there -- Sandman tried to do a step that he didn't complete so much as I completed mine. I did a step -- zee-zap-zee with one foot, then I'd cross my foot and do it, you know. You've got to see the picture in order to point out what I'm talking about.
However, we did the "Varsity Show" and finished.
